matches.rationale: No finding covers the relayer paying gas for authorizations without compensation until claim. Finding 15 is about unbounded arrays hitting the block gas limit, which is a different defect.
No finding identifies 64-bit withdrawId collisions. Finding 17 covers the same duplicate check but only raises a genesis block.number sentinel issue, which is a different defect.
Finding 1 identifies that DeployV1 never grants WITHDRAW_AUTHORITY_ROLE to the bridge, which makes every claimWithdrawal revert.
